videos.desc: A young woman in red boxing gloves trains in a gym: she punches her coach's pads next to the ring, works the heavy bag, hits the speed ball and laughs happily between rounds.

At an outdoor group workout a woman powers through burpees and star jumps, sprints up and down a long flight of stone steps and does box jumps while others catch their breath. She keeps bouncing and laughing while the rest of the group slumps over exhausted.

In a sunny garden a woman in workout clothes goes through her routine: jumping jacks, jogging on the spot, toe touches and side stretches. She finishes facing the camera with a big smile and two thumbs up, saying she does her exercise every day.
videos.said: I do my exercise every day. It is good for me.

videos.desc: A young woman with a braid and a big gym bag walks into a bright fitness center, passing rows of treadmills with runners, racks of dumbbells and cable machines, then drops her bag and looks around with excited hands on her hips.
At a track meet a young athlete sprints toward the high-jump bar, jumps and arches backwards over it, lands on the blue mat and springs up screaming with joy while teammates celebrate.
In a hand-painted anime scene, a young woman with a braid trains in an open wooden shelter by the sea, repeatedly kicking a hanging punching bag with high, powerful kicks.
In a 3D-animated gym, a huge strongman grips a loaded barbell, strains as he pulls it from the floor, and presses it triumphantly over his head with a proud grin before setting it down.

On a sunny rooftop terrace, a woman unrolls a purple yoga mat onto the tiles and starts stretching on it. A man joins with his own green mat, and the two do yoga poses side by side on their mats, finishing lying down relaxed.

A young man in a gym flexes and poses in front of the big wall mirror, moving in sync with his reflection like a game. Friends in yellow and purple shirts gather around and everyone flexes at the mirror, laughing.

In a gym, a skinny red-haired teen flexes his thin arms and groans at how small they look. A fit woman steps in and flexes visibly bigger biceps next to him, then a huge bearded bodybuilder flexes enormous muscles while the teen's jaw drops in shock.

A young Muay Thai fighter in blue gloves climbs through the ropes into a boxing ring at a gym, bounces and shadowboxes around the canvas, then leans on the ropes laughing while his coach splashes him with water.

A female athlete in an orange kit with a race number runs a road race along a waterfront boardwalk: she grabs a paper cup of water at an aid station, drinks while running, checks her sports watch, and pushes toward the barriered finish area past cheering spectators.

In a gym, a muscular woman steps barefoot onto a big white dial scale, then picks up two dumbbells and gapes in mock shock as the needle jumps higher; a giant bodybuilder takes her place and flexes his biceps at the spinning needle while she laughs and points.

At a packed outdoor pool, divers jump from high boards and towers one after another; each landing throws up a bigger and bigger burst of water while spectators film, ending with an enormous column of water.
Two runners in a birch park warm up: they reach their arms high overhead, lean to the side, bend down to touch their toes, and help each other with a partner stretch before jogging off.

Relay runners train on a red stadium running track at sunset: a woman sprints around the curve with a baton and hands it to a teammate, he runs on down the marked lanes into the low sun, and the last runner crosses with arms spread while the team cheers.

A young woman with a red hair bun runs on a treadmill in a bright gym, breathing hard as the pace picks up. She finishes the run, slows the machine with the console buttons and wipes her forehead with relief.
In a garage gym a woman carries a heavy round plate, swings a kettlebell, and a big man heaves a huge stone ball onto a wooden box with a shout. The two then flex their arms proudly beside the box.

In a Pixar-style animated gym, a woman in a purple tank top powers through a full workout — barbell squats, push-ups, kettlebell swings, punching-bag hits and pull-ups — cheered on by her small dog, then collapses happily on the mat shouting that she is done.
videos.said: One more! One more! Come on! Done! Ha ha!

videos.desc: A home gym with black walls, a squat rack, a red bench and a rack of weights along the wall. A big tattooed man in a white cap and blue T-shirt tries to train with four golden retrievers loose in the room. Lying on the rubber floor working an ab roller, he is swamped by dogs licking his face. He then lies back on the red bench and presses two heavy metal dumbbells straight up over his chest, arms locked out, while one dog climbs up and stands on his stomach and another pushes its nose into his side. At the end he does press-ups on the floor with his hands either side of a dog lying flat underneath him and two more lying on each side.
videos.said: Today I'm going to attempt to work out with four golden retrievers. Let's see how it goes.

videos.desc: A sprinter in a yellow and green vest drives out of the starting blocks on the red track of a packed Olympic stadium, body low and arms pumping. He straightens up, lengthens his stride and runs at full speed down his lane while the camera tracks alongside him, the crowd and the white stadium roof behind.

A close shot from the front of a red-haired woman in a black and green cycling jersey riding a spin bike in a packed gym class. She is bent over the handlebars, face red and mouth open, pushing the pedals as fast as she can while other riders work in the rows behind her. She keeps glancing down at the little blue console on the handlebars, and at the end she takes one hand off the bars and claps it to her forehead in disbelief at the number on the screen.

A woman in a pink vest climbs an overhanging limestone crag above a valley. She hangs off small holds by her fingertips with her arms taut and her feet smeared against the rock, a rope clipped to her harness running down below her and a chalk bag on her back. Two friends stand on the ground far below beside a crash pad, watching. She works her way up the bulge, pulls over the top of the block and looks back down, grinning.

A rower drives a narrow single scull across flat water in a navy racing suit. He hauls both oars through the stroke with his arms and shoulders straining, teeth bared and forehead screwed up. The camera closes in until only his face fills the frame: eyes squeezed shut, cheeks tight, mouth open and gasping, skin shining with sweat, hair stuck to his forehead. A line of spectators stands on the far bank under a blue sky.

An outdoor bootcamp session on a grass field at golden hour, with pull-up bars, mats and kettlebells set out and a trainer and other athletes working in the background. A woman in a dark red sports bra and leggings, with visible arm and stomach muscles, swings two heavy battle ropes up and down with both arms, her jaw set. She then swings a large black kettlebell up between her legs with both hands, breathing hard. Finally she jumps up onto a tall wooden plyo box, lands on top of it, straightens up with her arms thrown open and shouts in triumph while the trainer claps behind her.

A woman in a colourful cycling kit and a white helmet rides a road bike fast along a coastal mountain road; the camera tracks her from the front while grey cliffs, a fjord and green slopes pass behind her, other riders roll along the road ahead, and she finishes by riding across a bridge over the water, still pedalling hard.

In a gymnastics hall with a vaulting horse, a balance beam and blue landing mats, a young gymnast in training kit lands badly and sits down on the mat with her face screwed up in pain, clutching her bare foot. An older woman in a grey training shirt kneels beside her, takes the foot in her hands and winds a beige elastic bandage around the ankle, fastening it with tape. When the ankle is strapped the woman puts an arm around the gymnast's shoulders and holds her while she cries.

A group workout on a park lawn at golden hour, big trees behind and low sun flaring through the leaves. A woman in a grey crop top stands at the front with both arms stretched overhead, hands clasped, leaning to one side, and half a dozen people in gym clothes behind her copy the move. They drop into deep kneeling lunges with a hand on the front knee, then all jump on the spot swinging their arms up over their heads, then settle into wide side lunges with both arms held straight out, everyone moving together.
videos.said: That's the spot. Mmm, that feels good. So good.

videos.desc: A bouldering wall built inside an old stone church with tall stained-glass windows, an iron candle chandelier and a carved wooden pulpit. A young man in a blue T-shirt stands on thick blue crash mats and points up at a yellow hold, telling the climber where to go. A young woman with a blonde ponytail, in a lilac sports top and black leggings, grabs it and climbs higher to a green hold, and he lowers his arm and claps. Two young women sit on the mats behind; one cheers with her arms up.

On a sandy beach at sunset, with the sea, a striped umbrella and a volleyball net behind, two young women in swimsuits kneel on all fours side by side, laughing, forming the base of a human pyramid. A third young woman in a white swimsuit top and denim shorts crouches on their backs, straightens up with her arms spread wide and her hair blowing, and then throws both arms up in the air. Towels and handprints in the sand are around them.

In a gym hall with a wooden floor and high windows, a young man in a sweat-soaked grey vest and black shorts climbs a thick hanging rope near the ceiling beams, pulling himself up hand over hand with his legs wrapped around the rope, gritting his teeth and then grinning. Far below, a young man in black and a young woman in a grey top and black leggings hold on to two other ropes, start to climb and look up at him. Blue crash mats, boxes and a bowl of chalk sit along the wall.

In a gym with bare brick walls and a big window, a young man in a grey vest, blue shorts and grey hand wraps throws a hard punch into a large brown leather punching bag hanging on chains, and a puff of dust bursts out where his fist hits it. He pulls back his fist and moves around in a fighting stance, ready for the next punch. On the other side a young man in a cream vest holds the swinging bag steady. A skipping rope and a white water bottle lie on the floor mats.

A beach volleyball game at sunrise. A young woman in a black sports top and shorts dives low across the sand with her arms stretched out together and hits a blue and yellow volleyball high into the air, sand flying up behind her. She lands on her front, gets up on her knees and cheers with her fists raised. A volleyball net stands beside her, and friends at the edge of the court cheer and clap. Seagulls fly low over the beach and a jogger runs along the water's edge in the golden light.

In a boxing ring in an old brick gym, a young woman with braids, a black sports top, red shorts and red gloves throws a straight punch that meets the blue glove her opponent raises, sending sweat into the light. She then pulls her gloves back up to guard her face and steps back while her opponent moves out of sight. A referee in a white shirt and bow tie walks around the ring. Spectators crowd around the red ropes, and punching bags and old posters hang on the walls.

A red-haired young woman in a red puffer jacket, a knitted bobble hat and black snow trousers pulls a wooden sled up a snowy mountain slope in a snowstorm, with pine trees and a wooden cabin far behind. Three husky dogs wearing goggles sit on a tartan blanket in the sled, and another husky walks beside her on a lead. She stops, bends forward with her hands on her knees, breathing hard with clouds of breath, and then turns to look back at the dogs. A dropped mitten and a flask lie in the snow.

A rock-climbing spot under a big overhanging cliff at sunset, with fields and a river in the valley below. A young woman in a maroon top, black shorts and a climbing harness hangs in mid-air from a single rope, her feet off the rock, laughing as she swings. On the ground a bearded young man in a blue T-shirt holds the other end of the rope tight at his harness, leaning back to take all her weight and looking up at her. Dust rises from the gravel path, and a rope bag stands beside him.

A rooftop gym on a sunny day. A muscular young man in black shorts, with no shirt on and gritted teeth, swings a heavy sledgehammer high over his head and brings it down with all his strength onto a huge tractor tyre on the wooden deck, again and again; the tyre bounces up and dust and rubber bits burst into the air. A red towel hangs from his waistband. A young woman in a lilac sports top stands behind him and watches. A brick wall, a water tower and string lights stand against a blue sky.

A corridor in a sports centre with dark green tiled walls and bright strip lights. A young woman in a maroon sports top and black shorts stands calmly in front of a mirror, smiling as she slowly takes a selfie on her phone and touches her hair. Behind her a young man in a blue T-shirt with a bag on his shoulder leans against the wall with his arms folded, waiting. Two young men move a stack of black mats, and a bench holds a climbing rope and a chalk bag.
